build_MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder: build a MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder with configurable hidden dim, num queries, and decoder layers for mask classification
create_SelfAttentionLayer: create a SelfAttentionLayer with multihead attention, layer norm, and optional pre or post normalization
create_CrossAttentionLayer: create a CrossAttentionLayer that attends between query targets and memory features with positional embeddings
create_FFNLayer: create a FFNLayer with two linear layers, dropout, and layer normalization for transformer feedforward processing
run_forward_prediction_heads: run forward_prediction_heads to produce class logits, mask embeddings, and attention masks from decoder output
